### Get and transform data for analysis.
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~#

```{r}
df <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "/data/finalcollection/alldata.csv" ), header = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Time = "T1")

# From JSON-like character vectors to actual lists
df <- df %>% mutate(
  csPosition = map(csPosition, ~ if (is.character(.x)) fromJSON(.x) else .x),
  ratingCoordinate = map(ratingCoordinate, ~ if (is.character(.x)) fromJSON(.x) else .x)
)

#split coordinates for CS+ and ratings into two columns 
df <- df %>%
  mutate(csX = map_dbl(csPosition, 1), 
         csY = map_dbl(csPosition, 2)) 

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    rateX = map_dbl(ratingCoordinate, ~ if (length(.x) == 2) .x[[1]] else 0),
    rateY = map_dbl(ratingCoordinate, ~ if (length(.x) == 2) .x[[2]] else 0)
  )

#adjust for 1 indexing 
df$csX = df$csX+1
df$csY = df$csY+1
df$rateX = df$rateX+1
df$rateY = df$rateY+1
length(unique(df$ppt))
```

```{r}
#expand the navi section into 1 move x row {takes a little time}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    path_clean = gsub("'", "\"", path),
    moveTime_clean = gsub("'", "\"", moveTime)
  )

navigate_df <- df %>% filter(state == "navigating")

expanded_df <- navigate_df %>%
  mutate(
    parsed_path = map(path_clean, ~ fromJSON(.x)),
    parsed_time = map(moveTime_clean, ~ fromJSON(.x))
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(parsed_path, indices_to = "move") %>%
  mutate(
    move_col = map_dbl(parsed_path, "col"),
    move_row = map_dbl(parsed_path, "row"),
    move_time = map2_dbl(parsed_time, move, ~ .x[[.y]])
  ) %>%
  select(-parsed_path, -parsed_time) %>%
  mutate(move = as.character(move))

non_navigate <- df %>% filter(state != "navigating")

non_navigate <- non_navigate %>%
  mutate(
    move = NA_character_,
    move_col = NA_real_,
    move_row = NA_real_,
    move_time = NA_real_
  )

final_df <- bind_rows(expanded_df, non_navigate) 

#R indexing
final_df$move_col = final_df$move_col +1
final_df$move_row = final_df$move_row +1
```


```{r}
#feedback expand. 
final_df <- final_df %>%
  mutate(
    feedback_clean = gsub("'", "\"", feedback),

    # Parse feedback JSON per row
    feedback_parsed = map(feedback_clean, ~ {
      if (is.na(.x) || .x == "") return(NULL)
      tryCatch(fromJSON(.x), error = function(e) NULL)
    }),

    # Extract dogsLost by indexing with run
    dogsLost = map2_dbl(feedback_parsed, run, ~ {
      if (is.null(.x)) return(NA_real_)
      run_key <- as.character(.y)
      val <- .x[[run_key]]
      if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      return(as.numeric(val)) 
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-feedback_clean, -feedback_parsed)

```

#Main vars and useful func
```{r}
GRID_SIZE <- 11

# Func to convert string dictionary to a valid JSON format
parse_func <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("'", "\"", x)
  parsed_list <- fromJSON(x)
  return(unlist(parsed_list))
}


parse_df <- function(json_str) {
  if (is.na(json_str) || json_str %in% c("", "null", "0")) {  
    return(tibble(RUN = character(), saved = numeric()))  
  }
  
  parsed_list <- tryCatch(fromJSON(json_str), error = function(e) list())

  if (!length(parsed_list)) {
    return(tibble(RUN = character(), saved = numeric()))  
  }
  
  RUN <- names(parsed_list)
  saved <- as.numeric(unlist(parsed_list))

  # Remove entries where saved == 0
  valid_idx <- saved != 0
  RUN <- RUN[valid_idx]
  saved <- saved[valid_idx]

  if (length(RUN) != length(saved)) {
    return(tibble(RUN = character(), saved = numeric()))  
  }
  
  tibble(RUN = RUN, saved = saved)
}


# Function to calculate Euclidean distance
euclidean_distance <- function(coord, pos) {
  if (length(coord) != 2 || length(pos) != 2) return(NA)
  sqrt((coord[1] - pos[1])^2 + (coord[2] - pos[2])^2)
}

#extends a palette to n of colors needed
extend_palette <- function(palette_name, n) {
  pal <- wes_palette(palette_name, type = "discrete")
  if (length(pal) >= n) {
    return(pal[1:n])
  } else {
    return(rep(pal, length.out = n))
  }
}
```

# Reaction to feedback: mixed model 
```{r}
dfrun <- df %>%
  filter(state == "navigating") %>%
  distinct(ID, run, trial, nMoves, dogsLost) %>%
  group_by(ID, run) %>%
  summarise(moves = mean(nMoves, na.rm = TRUE),
            lost = first(dogsLost), .groups = "drop")

# change in moves from the previous run (t - (t-1)) and dogs lost in the previous run (t-1)
dfrun <- dfrun %>%
  arrange(ID, run) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(delta_moves = moves - lag(moves),
         lost_prev = lag(lost)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(delta_moves), !is.na(lost_prev))

m.simple <- lmer(moves ~ lost_prev + run + (1 | ID), data = dfrun)
car::Anova(m.simple)
summary(m.simple)
```


```{r}
# alternative outcome: mean distance to the storm
dfdist <- df %>%
  filter(state == "navigating") %>%
  mutate(dist_storm = sqrt((move_row - csX)^2 + (move_col - csY)^2)) %>%
  group_by(ID, run) %>%
  summarise(mean_dist = mean(dist_storm, na.rm = TRUE),
            lost = first(dogsLost), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(ID, run) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(lost_prev = lag(lost)) %>%  # dogs lost in the previous run
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(lost_prev))

m.simple.dist <- lmer(mean_dist ~ lost_prev + run + (1 | ID), data = dfdist)
car::Anova(m.simple.dist)
summary(m.simple.dist)
```

### RATINGS PRE / POST
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~#

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(distance = map2_dbl(ratingCoordinate, csPosition, euclidean_distance))

#add match no match condition
df_pre <- df %>% filter(state == "ratingPRE")
df_post <- df %>% filter(state == "ratingPOST")
df_pre <- df_pre %>%
  mutate(ratingCoordinate_str = map_chr(ratingCoordinate, ~ toString(.x)))
df_post <- df_post %>%
  mutate(ratingCoordinate_str = map_chr(ratingCoordinate, ~ toString(.x)))

# Merge PRE and POST
df_post <- df_post %>%
  group_by(ID, run) %>%
  mutate(Match = as.integer(ratingCoordinate_str %in% df_pre$ratingCoordinate_str[df_pre$ID == ID & df_pre$run == run])) %>% #match = 1, no match = 0
  ungroup()

df <- df %>%
  left_join(df_post %>% select(ID, run, ratingCoordinate, Match), 
            by = c("ID", "run", "ratingCoordinate"))

df_plot <- df %>%
  filter(state %in% c("ratingPRE", "ratingPOST")) %>%
  mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("ratingPRE", "ratingPOST")))


ggplot(data = df_plot, aes(x = rating, fill = state))+geom_histogram(bins = 15)+ theme_minimal()+theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+geom_vline(xintercept = 70, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") + scale_fill_paletteer_d("MexBrewer::Casita3")+labs(title = "Ratings PRE distribution")+facet_grid(.~state)+ scale_fill_manual(values = c("#91316D","#090049"))
```

# Ratings PRE across runs
```{r}
# one row per participant x run: mean PRE rating (rated tiles have the same distances from the storm in every run)
dfrate_runs <- df %>%
  filter(state == "ratingPRE") %>%
  group_by(ID, run, F1iip, F2iip, F3iip) %>%  # factor scores are constant per participant, kept for the factor model below
  summarise(mean_rating = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# plot: mean +/- SE across participants per run (same style as path length and distance across runs)
ggplot(dfrate_runs, aes(x = run, y = mean_rating)) +stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "ribbon", fill = "#E6A3EE", alpha = 0.5) +stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", color = "#91316D") +stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2, color = "#91316D") +expand_limits(y = 0)+coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 70)) +scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, 10)) +scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:8) +labs(x = "Run", y = "Ratings (pre), mean (± SE)") +theme_classic() +theme(aspect.ratio = 1,axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14))

# change over runs: random intercept and random slope for run per participant
m.rate.run <- lmer(mean_rating ~ run + (1 + run | ID), data = dfrate_runs)
car::Anova(m.rate.run)
summary(m.rate.run)

#check for factor effects
m.rate.run.fac <- lmer(mean_rating ~ run * (F1iip + F2iip + F3iip) + (1 + run | ID), data = dfrate_runs)
car::Anova(m.rate.run.fac)
summary(m.rate.run.fac)
```


# Ratings PRE and feedback from the previous run
```{r}
# Do participants rate threat higher after losing more dogs in the previous run?

lost_runs <- df %>%
  filter(state == "navigating") %>%
  distinct(ID, run, dogsLost) %>%
  arrange(ID, run) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(lost_prev = lag(dogsLost)) %>%  # dogs lost in the previous run
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ID, run, lost_prev)

# run 0 has no previous feedback and is dropped
dfrate_fb <- dfrate_runs %>%
  left_join(lost_runs, by = c("ID", "run")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lost_prev))

m.rate.fb <- lmer(mean_rating ~ lost_prev + run + (1 | ID), data = dfrate_fb)
car::Anova(m.rate.fb)
summary(m.rate.fb)
```

# Ratings PRE and feedback: do the factors change the reaction to feedback?
```{r}
# same model as m.rate.fb in the chunk above, with the factors added
# lost_prev x factor: does the association with feedback differ with the factor scores?
m.rate.fb.fac <- lmer(mean_rating ~ lost_prev * (F1iip + F2iip + F3iip) + run + (1 | ID), data = dfrate_fb)
car::Anova(m.rate.fb.fac)
```

#Worry/IOU Factor associated with AUC
```{r}
# Get AUC using trapezoidal rule
dfauc <- df[df$state == "ratingPRE" | df$state == "ratingPOST",] %>%
  arrange(ID, distance)

auc_results <- dfauc %>%
  group_by(ID, run, state) %>%
  summarise(AUC = sum((lead(distance) - distance) * 
                      (rating + lead(rating)) / 2, na.rm = TRUE),
              F1iip = first(F1iip),
            F2iip = first(F2iip),
            F3iip = first(F3iip)
            )

auc_results2 <- auc_results %>%
  group_by(ID, F1iip,F2iip,F3iip, state) %>%
  summarise(mean_auc = mean(AUC))

auc_long <- auc_results2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(F1iip, F2iip, F3iip),
    names_to = "factor",
    values_to = "score"
  )
```

#Factors Median split
```{r}
df_long <- df %>%
  filter(state == "ratingPRE") %>%
  select(ID, distance, rating, F1iip, F2iip, F3iip) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(F1iip, F2iip, F3iip), names_to = "factor", values_to = "score") %>%

  mutate(group = ifelse(score <= median(score, na.rm = TRUE), "Low", "High")) %>%

  group_by(factor, distance, group) %>%
  summarise(

  )
```

### 4) Change in ratings and change in behaviour across runs
```{r}
# Did participants who changed their threat ratings more over runs also change their behaviour more?
# per participant: slope over runs (simple linear regression per person) of
#   mean PRE rating (dfrate_runs, ratings section), path length and distance from storm (dfruns, chunk above)
slopes <- dfruns %>%
  left_join(dfrate_runs, by = c("ID", "run")) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(slope_rating = coef(lm(mean_rating ~ run))[2],
            slope_moves  = coef(lm(moves ~ run))[2],
            slope_dist   = coef(lm(mean_dist ~ run))[2],
            .groups = "drop")

# Pearson correlations
cor.test(slopes$slope_rating, slopes$slope_moves, method = "pearson")
cor.test(slopes$slope_rating, slopes$slope_dist, method = "pearson")

# one point per participant
slopes_long <- slopes %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(slope_moves, slope_dist), names_to = "measure", values_to = "slope_behaviour") %>%
  mutate(measure = recode(measure, slope_moves = "Path length (moves)", slope_dist = "Distance from storm"))

ggplot(slopes_long, aes(x = slope_rating, y = slope_behaviour)) +geom_point(color = '#E6A3EE', alpha = 0.7) +geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y") +stat_cor(aes(label = paste(..r.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")), method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") +labs(x = "Change in ratings (pre) per run", y = "Change in behaviour per run") +theme_classic() +theme(aspect.ratio = 1,axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),strip.text = element_text(size = 14))
```


#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
### H1: Does generalisation impact avoidance

#Avoidance threshold
#Fit logistic function to data --> at which rating do ppt avoid?

```{r}
# Binarise visited / not visited
joint_df <- joint_df %>%
  mutate(visited = as.integer(visits > 0))

# Logistic function
logistic <- function(x, x0, k) {
  1 / (1 + exp(-k * (x - x0)))
}

# Function to fit logistic per ID x run
fit_logistic_model <- function(df) {
  id <- unique(df$ID)
  run <- unique(df$run)
  x <- df$ratingPRE
  y <- df$visited
  
  fit <- tryCatch({
    nlsLM(
      y ~ 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (x - x0))),
      start = list(x0 = 50, k = 0.1),
      lower = c(x0 = 0, k = -10),
      upper = c(x0 = 100, k = 10),
      control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 200)
    )
  }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(ID = id, run = run, inflection_point = NA, slope = NA, rss = NA, r2 = NA))
  }
  
  coefs <- coef(fit)
  rss <- deviance(fit)
  tss <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  r2 <- 1 - rss / tss
  
  data.frame(ID = id, run = run, inflection_point = coefs["x0"], slope = coefs["k"], rss = rss, r2 = r2)
}

# Fit logistic model per ID x run
log_res <- joint_df %>%
  split(list(joint_df$ID, joint_df$run)) %>%
  map_dfr(fit_logistic_model)

# Average threshold and slope per participant (across runs)
log_res_avg <- log_res %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    inflection_point = mean(inflection_point, na.rm = TRUE),
    slope = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_threshold = sd(inflection_point, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_slope = sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_runs = sum(!is.na(inflection_point)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

log_res_avg
log_res = log_res_avg
```

```{r}
joint_df_pred <- joint_df %>%
  left_join(log_res, by = "ID")

# Generate predicted curves + slope category
curve_data <- joint_df_pred %>%
  group_by(ID, sticsa_score) %>%
  summarise(
    inflection_point = first(inflection_point),
    slope = first(slope)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(inflection_point)) %>%
  mutate(
    slope_sign = if_else(slope > 0, "Slope > 0", "Slope ≤ 0")  # add slope category
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(data = list(
    tibble(
      ratingPRE = seq(0, 100, length.out = 200),
      pred = 1 / (1 + exp(-slope * (ratingPRE - inflection_point)))
    )
  )) %>%
  unnest(data)

ggplot(curve_data, aes(x = ratingPRE, y = pred, group = ID)) +geom_line(color = "#91316D", alpha = 0.4) +facet_wrap(~ slope_sign) +labs(x = "Rating (pre)",y = "Predicted Probability of Visiting") +theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```

```{r}
  count(slope_sign) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100)

slope_summary

positive_slope_IDs <- unique(log_res_clean$ID[log_res_clean$slope_sign == "positive"])
```

### Does visiting a specific location change ratings?
```{r}
#get POST-PRE CHANGE
df_pre_avg <- df %>%
  filter(state == "ratingPRE") %>%
  group_by(ID, run, distance, rateX, rateY, sticsa_score, sticsa_cognitive,sticsa_somatic,ius_score, tics_score, pswq_score, idas_score, cape_scoredistressed, cape_scorefeel, F1iip, F2iip, F3iip
) %>%
  summarise(ratingPRE = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_post <- df %>%
  filter(state == "ratingPOST" & Match == 1) %>% #only matching ones
  select(ID, run, distance, rateX, rateY, ratingPOST = rating)

df_wide <- full_join(df_pre_avg, df_post, by = c("ID", "run", "distance", "rateX", "rateY"))
df_wide$changeRatings = df_wide$ratingPOST-df_wide$ratingPRE
df_wide <- df_wide[!is.na(df_wide$changeRatings), ]


df_by_ppt <- df %>%
  filter(state == "navigating") %>%
  mutate(
    distance = round(sqrt((move_row - csX)^2 + (move_col - csY)^2))
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, move_col, move_row, run) %>%
  summarise(visits = n(), .groups = "drop")

df_by_ppt$rateX <- df_by_ppt$move_row
df_by_ppt$rateY <- df_by_ppt$move_col


joint_df <- left_join(df_wide, df_by_ppt, by = c("ID", "rateX", "rateY", "run"))
joint_df$visits[is.na(joint_df$visits)] <- 0 #assign 0 to never visited
```

# Fitterd parameters
```{r}
dflst <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "/output/GP_parameters/params&fitBOTH.csv"), header = TRUE)

dflst <- dflst %>%
  select(ID, run, model, ratings, WAIC, mean, Unnamed..0) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Unnamed..0, 
    values_from = mean
  )

dfp <- dflst %>%
  group_by(ID, ratings, model) %>%
  summarise(mean_ls = mean(ls_subject_transformed),
            mean_peak = mean(peak_subject_transformed))

#plot fitted params (euc_rbf_peak, PRE ratings): one point per participant, ls and peak as subplots
dfp_params <- dfp %>%
  filter(model == "euc_rbf_peak", ratings == "ratingPRE", ID %in% unique(df$ID)) %>%  # only participants kept in the task data (236)
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_ls, mean_peak), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(parameter = recode(parameter, mean_ls = "ls", mean_peak = "peak"))

# separate plots for ls and peak, same visuals as the weight and pessimism plots
ggplot(dfp_params %>% filter(parameter == "ls"), aes(x = "", y = value)) +geom_boxplot(fill = "grey", alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color="#090049") +theme_classic() +theme(aspect.ratio = 2,axis.title.x = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),axis.text = element_text(size = 14)) +ylab("Estimated length scale") +expand_limits(y = 0)

#ggsave(paste0(data_path, "/output/Plots/parametersbeliefsls.pdf"),width = 4,height = 4,dpi = 600,bg = "white")

ggplot(dfp_params %>% filter(parameter == "peak"), aes(x = "", y = value)) +geom_boxplot(fill = "grey", alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color="#090049") +theme_classic() +theme(aspect.ratio = 2,axis.title.x = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),axis.text = element_text(size = 14)) +ylab("Estimated peak") +ylim(0, 100)

#ggsave(paste0(data_path, "/output/Plots/parametersbeliefspeak.pdf"),width = 4,height = 4,dpi = 600,bg = "white")

# mean and sd across participants per parameter
dfp_params %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(value)))
```

#ls change over runs per participant
```{r}

# fixed effect of run = average change of ls per run
# random slope of run = how much participants differ in that change (see SD of run under Random effects)
m.ls.slope <- lmer(mean_ls ~ run + (run | ID), data = dfls_runs)
summary(m.ls.slope)

# each participant's own change per run: how many go down vs up
ls_change <- coef(m.ls.slope)$ID$run
ggplot(data.frame(ls_change), aes(x = ls_change)) +geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = '#E6A3EE') +geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +theme_minimal() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +labs(x = "ls change per run", y = "Participants", title = "Individual ls change over runs")
mean(ls_change < 0)  # proportion of participants whose ls decreases
```

```{r}
# does the fitted peak differ from true CS value? 
true_value <- 70
peak_vals <- dfp_params$value[dfp_params$parameter == "peak"]

# one-sample t-test against the true value (mean), with Cohen's d
t.test(peak_vals, mu = true_value)
(mean(peak_vals) - true_value) / sd(peak_vals)

# robustness check without normality assumption: Wilcoxon signed-rank test (pseudo-median)
wilcox.test(peak_vals, mu = true_value, conf.int = TRUE)
```

```{r}
dfmu <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "/gen-avo/behavioral-modeling/MDP/fitted_mu.csv"), header = TRUE)

extract_reward <- function(x) {
  cleaned <- gsub("\\[|\\]|\\n", " ", x)
  nums <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(cleaned, "\\s+")))
  nums <- nums[!is.na(nums)]
  return(nums) 
}

dfmu <- dfmu %>%
  mutate(rewards = lapply(rewards, extract_reward))

  mutate(reward_list = map(rewards, ~ as.numeric(.x))) %>%
```

#BIC with penalty for the GP parameters (generalised beliefs model)
```{r}
# conservative check, we count them as 2 extra parameters per run.
# where BIC = (number of parameters × ln(number of data points)) − 2 × fit

# get number of moves per trial (n) from BIC
#    BIC - AIC = k*log(n) - 2k  ->  log(n) = (BIC - AIC)/2 + 2
dfmdp$n_moves <- round(exp((dfmdp$bic_w - dfmdp$aic_w) / 2 + 2))
table(dfmdp$n_moves)  # check: should be whole numbers of moves

# penalty once per run as GP fitted once
pen_run <- dfmdp %>%
  group_by(participant, run) %>%
  summarise(n_run = sum(n_moves, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(penalty = 2 * log(n_run)) #this comes from penalty in BIC term 

# add penalty to the summed BIC of the generalised beliefs model
pen_ppt <- pen_run %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(penalty = sum(penalty), .groups = "drop")

summed_pen <- summed_df %>%
  left_join(pen_ppt, by = "participant") %>%
  mutate(bic_w = bic_w + penalty)

# 4) compare models again: total BIC (lower = better) and best-fitting model per participant
colSums(summed_df[, bic_cols])   # original
colSums(summed_pen[, bic_cols])  # with penalty

summed_pen$best_fit <- apply(summed_pen[, bic_cols], 1, function(x) bic_cols[which.min(x)])
table(original = summed_df$best_fit, penalised = summed_pen$best_fit)
```

```{r}
sum_bic_pen_df <- data.frame(
```

```{r}
plot_cor_heatmap <- function(dat, title) {
  cm <- cor(dat, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cm_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cm))
  ggplot(cm_long, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = Freq)) +geom_tile(color = "white") +geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq))) +scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#090049", mid = "white", high = "#91316D", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +theme_minimal() +theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)) +labs(fill = "rho", title = title)
}

# all parameters (GP, weighted MDP, pessimistic MDP)

# generalisation model only 
plot_cor_heatmap(par_all %>% select(ls, peak, beta_w, weight), "Correlation of GP and MDP model parameters")
```
